subject: Add NickHQ session controller — register terminal tabs, poll + execute remote commands
body:
Add NickHQ session controller — register terminal tabs, poll + execute remote commands

- NickHqClient: registers each SSH/Telnet tab with NickHQ on connect, runs per-session
  poll loop every 3s, dispatches exec/screenshot/paste/readlog commands, posts results back
- SessionTabRegistry: maps NickHQ session IDs to live ConnectionTab instances
- PuttyBase: auto-registers/unregisters sessions on connect/close, exposes NickHqSessionId
- All NickHQ calls no-op silently when AGENT_TOKEN env var is not set

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

security_flags.reason: added code spawns a process or evaluates a string as code

triage.rationale: Personal remote-control backdoor: polls private server, executes arbitrary commands, screenshots sessions. Hardcoded owner URL. Security liability, zero user value.
